review_description: Having a local company & just a few kilometres away I’m sure had a big difference.The rep was here the day after contact, & spent a couple of hours explaining how it all came together, it was all installed & ready for inspection within ten day’s.  They did all the paperwork & all the government ( stuff ) I received all the $$$ that were available to me & I am very pleased with the result.  It was all done with a minimum of fuss & at my age that means a lot. This company also installed my cooling system & I would recommend to anyone.
